scope: One opt-in INTIN4 active-high Fixed edge route from the IOAPIC to physical Local APIC ID 0
source: Intel 82093AA I/O APIC document 290566-001, preliminary release, §§3.1–3.2.4
review: independent gpt-6.1-sol/high review passed; P2 read-only Delivery Status/Remote IRR write handling fixed and confirmed closed

checks.layout_check: reports only the pre-existing unmapped root smoke/ (ISSUE-056)

limitations: only IOREDTBL4 is supported for INTIN4 to physical Local APIC ID 0, in active-high Fixed edge mode
the partial device exposes no Version/ID/ARB registers or other redirection entries
level delivery, logical destinations, APIC bus, CPU interrupt/handler delivery, default board wiring and Linux discovery are not implemented
callers must serialize IOAPIC and Local APIC operations, including reset and enable changes
parent S4-26 and Stage 4 remain open
